paper_id: Non-autoregressive Model for Full-line Code Completion
title: Non-autoregressive Model for Full-line Code Completion
motivation: AR模型逐token生成导致代码补全延迟高，无法在开发者设备上即时响应
problem_framing: 代码行内token依赖弱于NMT，可并行生成；左到右生成顺序非最优
key_insight: 通过依赖分析验证代码token可并行预测，语法感知采样策略可增强NAR训练
method_signature: SANAR：编码器-解码器Transformer + 条件独立因式分解 + 语法感知采样
evaluation_criteria: BLEU、精确匹配率、编辑相似度、延迟、加速比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: NAR模型token重复率略高于AR模型但未造成实际问题
evidence_for_taste: the generation is not parallelizable and thus particularly slow
the dependency among code tokens is weaker than that among tokens in natural languages
left-to-right is not always optimal for code completion
our syntax-guided sampling strategy can increase the probability of glancing the keyword, operators, and identifiers
only evaluating the quality by comparing the exact match with the ground truth is not convincing enough
thinking_moves: 先验证假设：分析代码token依赖弱于NMT，逆转生成顺序验证非必需
从NMT成功经验迁移NAR到代码生成，论证领域特殊性
设计针对代码语法的采样策略（关键词、标识符、操作符优先）
用多种指标评估生成质量（BLEU、编辑相似度而非仅精确匹配）
